title: Skyblock Parkour（International Edition）
description:
Challenge Your Limits, Soar Above the Clouds!
Skyblock Parkour (International Edition) delivers heart-pounding aerial parkour action.
Expertly designed levels with progressive difficulty
Butter-smooth controls for precise movement
Compete globally on real-time leaderboards
Do you have what it takes to conquer the sky?
Right-click/Press B to open inventory.
